entry.title: Stay with a favorite page
entry.summary: Share a simple book about familiar people or things. Follow the page that interests your baby, even if you never finish the book.
entry.cue: Your baby looks closely, reaches for a page, or responds to a familiar picture.
detail: The authors suggest sturdy board books, simple pictures and subjects from daily life. Describe what your baby is looking at, or enjoy the picture together.
A small book of family photographs is another possibility. Let page turning and looking be part of the experience; reading backward or returning to one page can belong too.
